About Nai Yang

Nai Yang is in the north-west of Phuket, in Thalang district, next to Nai Yang Beach and Sirinat National Park. The airport is only a short drive away: the project data gives about 2 km (7 minutes) for Botanica Skyport and descriptions of the condominiums put it at five to ten minutes, which is the main practical difference from the southern and central west-coast areas.

Most projects here are condominiums, mainly from Rhom Bho Property (The Title) plus The Balcony, The Olive and one project by The Zero, and several are pre-sale or under construction with units listed under the foreign quota. Botanica Skyport is a pool-villa project for buyers who want a house near the airport; the area is also close to Blue Canyon Golf Club and Mai Khao.

Why buyers choose Nai Yang

  • About 2 km from the airport
  • National park beach with shade trees
  • Low-rise, village atmosphere
  • Nai Thon and Mai Khao beaches nearby

Neighbouring areas in our catalogue: Mai Khao · Layan

Lifestyle and amenities

Nai Yang has beach restaurants, small shops and a local market. It is calm in the evenings; larger shopping centres are a drive away.

Beaches and surroundings

Nai Yang Beach is protected by an offshore reef, which makes it calmer than many west-coast beaches. Casuarina trees give shade, and the national park limits large-scale development along the sand.

Rental demand in Nai Yang

Nai Yang rentals benefit from airport proximity: short stays at the start or end of a holiday and guests who want a quiet beach. Long-term demand comes from airport and hospitality staff.

Short-term holiday rentals

Demand from travellers who want a quiet beach near the airport; strongest in the dry season.

Long-term rentals

Airport and hotel staff and long-stay visitors.

Suitable property types

Condos with resort facilities and small villas.

Advantages and limitations

Advantage: unique airport access and a protected beach. Limitations: aircraft noise in some locations and fewer amenities.

Nai Yang: frequently asked questions

How close is Nai Yang to Phuket airport?

Our project data puts Nai Yang projects about 2 km from Phuket International Airport, often under 10 minutes by car.

Is there aircraft noise in Nai Yang?

Planes approach over the coast here, so noise depends on the exact location. Visit the site at different times before buying.

Is Nai Yang Beach good for swimming?

Yes, the offshore reef keeps it calmer than many west-coast beaches, especially in the dry season.

Is Nai Yang part of a national park?

Nai Yang Beach is within Sirinat National Park, which limits development along the beach.

Is Nai Yang a good place to live?

It suits people who want a quiet beach village and quick airport access; larger shopping and nightlife areas are further south.

How much does property in Nai Yang cost?

Advertised starting prices for projects in Nai Yang run from ฿3,100,000 to ฿19,900,000 (6 of 6 projects publish a price). These are lowest advertised prices; ask us to confirm current availability.
